typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'USE PDS_2008  DECLARE @REPORTDATE DATETIME = ? DECLARE @CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4) = ?  IF @REPORTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SELECT @REPORTDATE = CONVERT(DATE,MAX(CALL_CALLDATETIME)) FROM PDS_CALL WHERE CALL_CALLDATETIME <= GETDATE()  DECLARE @CD_BEGINDATE DATETIME = DATEADD(HOUR,-2,@REPORTDATE) DECLARE @CD_ENDDATE DATETIME = DATEADD(HOUR,12,@CD_BEGINDATE)  DECLARE @CALLLIST_IID INT SELECT @CALLLIST_IID = CALLLIST_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST WHERE CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD  DECLARE @MEMBERS TABLE (CALLLISTMASTER_IID BIGINT,MEMBER_IID BIGINT)  INSERT INTO @MEMBERS (CALLLISTMASTER_IID,MEMBER_IID) SELECT CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = @CALLLIST_IID 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @CD_BEGINDATE AND @CD_ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1  DECLARE @CALLS TABLE (MEMBER_IID BIGINT,CALL_IID BIGINT,CALL_DATE DATETIME,ATTEMPT INT)  INSERT INTO @CALLS (MEMBER_IID,CALL_IID,CALL_DATE,ATTEMPT) SELECT T.MEMBER_IID,C.CALL_IID,CONVERT(DATE,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) AS CALL_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.MEMBER_IID ORDER BY C.CALL_CALLDATETIME) AS ATTEMPT FROM @MEMBERS T 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON T.MEMBER_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 		AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = @CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE >= CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID  SELECT	M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBER_ID, 		M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME + \' \' + M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, 		M.MEMBER_MCAID_MARKET_CD AS MARKET, 		M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT, 		UJ.UNITJOB_NAME, 		@CALLLIST_CD AS CALLLIST_CD, 		C.CALL_PHONENUMBER AS NUMBER_CALLED, 		PS.PHONESOURCE_CD, 		ISNULL(HHM.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,\'\') AS HH_MEMBER, 		CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT, 		C.CALL_CALLDATETIME AS CALL_DATE, 		TC.ATTEMPT AS ATTEMPTS, 		C.CALL_AGENT AS AGENT, 		DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD, 		DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD AS DISPOSITION, 		MEMD.MEMD_SIG_DT AS APP_SIGN_DT, 		ML.MEMBER_LANGUAGE_LANGUAGE AS MEMBER_LANGUAGE FROM @MEMBERS TM 	INNER JOIN @CALLS TC ON TM.MEMBER_IID = TC.MEMBER_IID 		AND TC.CALL_DATE = @REPORTDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = TM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_IID = TM.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_IID = TC.CALL_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 		AND \'91\' + MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE = C.CALL_PHONENUMBER 		AND C.CALL_CALLDATETIME BETWEEN MP.MEMBERPHONE_BEGIN_DT AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_END_DT 	INNER JOIN PDS_PHONESOURCE PS ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID = PS.PHONESOURCE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 		AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = @CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES CDO ON CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_CALLLIST_IID = @CALLLIST_IID 		AND CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONGROUP DG ON COALESCE(CDO.CALLLIST_DISPOSITIONCODE_OVERRIDES_DISPOSITIONCODE_DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID) = DG.DISPOSITIONGROUP_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON UJ.UNITJOB_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER HHM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_HOH_MEMBER_IID = HHM.MEMBER_IID 		AND HHM.MEMBER_IID <> M.MEMBER_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[PDS_MEMD_MECR] MEMD ON MEMD.MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 		AND MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD = \'PBP\' 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER_LANGUAGE ML ON ML.MEMBER_LANGUAGE_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID ORDER BY M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,TC.ATTEMPT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceQuery
SourceQuery sink(input(
		HH_MEMBER as string,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		UNITJOB_NAME as string,
		PHONESOURCE_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as integer,
		DISPOSITION as string,
		APP_SIGN_DT as string,
		AGENT as string,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CALL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ATTEMPTS as integer,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE as string,
		CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NUMBER_CALLED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		HH_MEMBER,
		DISPOSITIONGROUP_CD,
		MEMBER_NAME,
		MARKET,
		UNITJOB_NAME,
		PHONESOURCE_CD,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		DISPOSITION,
		APP_SIGN_DT,
		AGENT,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBER_ID,
		PRODUCT,
		CALL_DATE,
		ATTEMPTS,
		MEMBER_LANGUAGE,
		CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT,
		NUMBER_CALLED)) ~> FlatFileDestination
